verdict.rationale: Anytype documents an MCP server that lets AI assistants interact with its API 'through natural language' and an agents-skill for running scripts against data via natural-language-driven coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.), plus a local API and CLI enabling automation. However, this is framed as enabling external AI assistants to control Anytype, not a native in-app NL command interface, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence confirming reliability of NL command execution. Missing for 10: first-party in-app natural-language command UI, independent/hands-on verification of the MCP/agent workflow actually working end-to-end.
